title: Spiderweb-PR Spatial Layer Binding Registry
description: Rendering/spatial metadata for layers already named in configs/layer_catalog.yaml (the labels-only catalog). Kept as a separate file so the labels catalog's tested invariant — no geometry/coordinates bound, every layer status=deferred — is never touched by this registry. Each entry's layer_id must exist in layer_catalog.yaml (enforced by tests/test_spatial_layer_bindings.py, not by this schema, since cross-file references aren't expressible in JSON Schema alone).

extent_id.description: References a boundary_id in configs/spatial_boundaries.yaml (typically the analytical domain) used to validate/clip requests for this layer.

vertical_datum.description: Required for layers carrying elevation/depth values (terrain/bathymetry). Omitted for purely planimetric layers.
